<english>: The БМПТ-34 (Russian: "heavy infantry combat vehicle") was a Soviet tracked armoured vehicle on the T-34 chassis. It was developed by the end of 1943 and built at Plant No. 174 in Omsk. It was designed to work both as a self-propelled anti-aircraft gun and as a fire support vehicle for infantry, and it carried two 25 mm 72-K guns in an open-topped turret. A first batch was completed at the end of 1943, series production ran from 1944 to 1948, and about 1,190 vehicles were built in total.
